description: This file contains helper functions for testing a parallel checkout process in a Git-related environment. It defines functions to configure checkout settings, verify that the checkout process used the expected number of workers, and confirm the correctness of checked-out workspaces.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Configures checkout workers and threshold using global test configuration functions.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a specified command and checks whether it used the expected number of checkout workers by analyzing trace logs.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the checkout in a given repository is correct by checking the diff and status.
